segments.PHP.1.3-6: Paul thanks God for the Philippians and their partnership
segments.PHP.1.9-11: Paul prays that the Philippians’ love will grow
segments.PHP.1.12-14: Paul’s chains help the gospel spread and make others bold
segments.PHP.1.15-17: Some preach Christ from envy, others from love
segments.PHP.1.20-20: Paul hopes to honor Christ by his life or his death
segments.PHP.1.21-21: Paul says that for him to live is Christ and to die is gain
segments.PHP.1.22-24: Paul is torn between dying to be with Christ and staying
segments.PHP.1.25-26: Paul is sure he will stay to help the Philippians’ joy
segments.PHP.1.27-27: Paul tells the Philippians to live worthy of the gospel
segments.PHP.1.28-30: Paul tells the Philippians not to fear those who oppose them
segments.PHP.2.1-2: Paul asks the Philippians to be united in love and purpose
segments.PHP.2.3-4: Paul tells the Philippians to be humble and care for others
segments.PHP.2.5-8: Christ humbled himself and obeyed even to death on a cross
segments.PHP.2.9-11: God raises Christ high, and all will say he is Lord
segments.PHP.2.22-24: Paul praises Timothy’s service and hopes to come soon
segments.PHP.2.28-30: Paul asks the Philippians to welcome and honor Epaphroditus
segments.PHP.3.4-5: Paul lists his own reasons for confidence in the flesh
segments.PHP.3.6-7: Paul counts his gains as loss for the sake of Christ
segments.PHP.3.8-11: Paul counts all things as loss to know Christ and his power
segments.PHP.3.12-14: Paul says he has not arrived but presses on toward the goal
segments.PHP.4.4-7: Paul tells the Philippians to rejoice, pray, and not worry
segments.PHP.4.10-13: Paul thanks the Philippians and says he is content in Christ
segments.PHP.4.14-17: Paul thanks the Philippians for sharing in his needs
